name: Detection & Attribution Evasion
description: Hiding AI-system compromise from the operator — masquerading as legitimate agents or users, stripping provenance, exploiting gaps in tool/agent logging, or flooding telemetry so real signals are lost.
differs: Catalog entry R030 (Telemetry evasion) is the observable indicator; this is the technique. Frequently paired with reporting_integrity = omitted / misrepresented in the IoPC envelope. Deceiving a defender's AI analyser is AI Analysis Evasion (T9.004).
